BiblicalUsage: I will greatly rejoice in the Lord, says Isaiah, for He hath clothed me with the garments of salvation, He hath covered me with the robe of righteousness.
TheologicalSignificance: I believe clothing is one of Scripture's great pictures of grace: God does not patch our rags, He clothes us head to foot, and the robe He gives is righteousness itself.
Sources: Strong's Exhaustive Concordance (1890), via OpenScriptures Strong's Dictionary (CC BY-SA)
